title: KB Creation Framework — Pipeline State
description: Schema for sources/pipeline_state.yaml (v3.1.11+). Records the intended Phase 0.0 model assignment and the per-phase actual dispatch results per Rule 20 (Model Provenance Honesty) in 01-shared-axioms.md. Used by Generate-QualityScorecard.ps1 to evaluate Rule 19 family separation against actuals; used by Validate-PipelineState.ps1 to lint Rule 20 integrity (intended_handle drift, missing required phases, family-lookup mismatches against the model registry).

framework_version.description: The framework version that produced this state file. v3.1.11 introduced the YAML format; earlier versions used pipeline_state.md.

model_assignment.description: Phase 0.0 intended assignment. Per Rule 20, every phase_log[].intended_handle MUST be one of these handle values. Mid-build re-assignment is permitted only via the Mid-Build Override Flow which atomically rewrites this block + appends a mid_build_overrides[] entry.

phase_log.description: One entry per dispatch. For per-topic content phases, log one entry per (builder, topic) pair. Rule 20 violations: missing required fields; intended_handle not in model_assignment; dispatch_status not in enum.

phase_id.description: Phase identifier like '5.2' or '5.2-topic-1-formation'. The numeric prefix is used for Rule 19 cross-phase pair lookup.

role.description: Framework role (Lead | Builder A | Builder B | Critic | Fact-checker | Auditor | Reviewer | Stress-test memo fact-checker). Used by Quality Scorecard's within-phase distinctness checks (Builder A vs Builder B; Lead-acted-as-Builder anti-pattern).

intended_handle.description: Per Rule 20 integrity (v3.1.10): MUST be one of the handle values in model_assignment. The orchestrator MUST NOT invent per-phase handles.

actual_model_id.description: The model_id the adapter's dispatch.ps1 actually called. For OpenCode silent-fallback to parent, this is the parent model_id, NOT the intended.

actual_family.description: From model-registry.yaml lookup by actual_model_id. Required for Rule 19 family-separation evaluation.

dispatch_status.description: Rule 20 enum. dispatched-with-substitution: actual != intended without operator acknowledgment (e.g., OpenCode silent fallback). dispatched-after-override: actual != intended because mid-build override flow re-assigned. failed-then-acknowledged-opt-out: operator explicitly acknowledged Rule 19 degradation for this dispatch.

dispatch_fingerprint_match.description: v3.1.10: did the response's DISPATCH-FINGERPRINT match the expected one from opencode.json? Required true for dispatched-as-intended on OpenCode hosts.

mid_build_overrides.description: Operator-acknowledged mid-build re-assignments. Each entry MUST correspond to an atomic rewrite of model_assignment + a subsequent phase_log entry with dispatch_status: dispatched-after-override.
